lines.beaver_en: This is the ER. How are you related to the patient?
lines.en: He's my father. He suddenly collapsed.

lines.beaver_en: What did you do when he collapsed?
lines.en: I gave first aid and called 119 right away.

lines.beaver_en: Well done. Does he take any regular medicine?
lines.en: Not only blood pressure pills, but herbal medicine too.

lines.beaver_en: Where did he get the herbal medicine?
lines.en: From a local Korean medicine clinic. They say it works well.

lines.beaver: 의약품과 한약을 같이 드시면 위험할 수 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Taking pharmaceuticals with herbal medicine can be risky.
lines.beaver_roman: Uiyakpumgwa hanyageul gachi deusimyeon wiheomhal su itseumnida.
lines.learner: 그건 몰랐어요. 의사 선생님께 꼭 말씀드릴게요.
lines.en: I didn't know that. I'll be sure to tell the doctor.
lines.roman: Geugeon mollasseoyo. Uisa seonsaengnimkke kkok malsseumdeurilgeyo.

lines.en: He had a health checkup last year, and it was fine.

lines.beaver_en: How are you now? You must have been shocked too.
lines.learner: 저는 괜찮아요. 아버지가 완쾌하실 수 있을까요?
lines.en: I'm okay. Will my father make a full recovery?
lines.roman: Jeoneun gwaenchanayo. Abeojiga wankwaehasil su isseulkkayo?

lines.beaver: 검사 결과를 봐야 하지만 의식은 돌아오셨습니다.
lines.beaver_en: We need the test results, but he's regained consciousness.
lines.beaver_roman: Geomsa gyeolgwareul bwaya hajiman uisigeun doraosyeotseumnida.
lines.learner: 다행이에요. 응급 상황에는 뭘 조심해야 해요?
lines.en: What a relief. What should I be careful of in an emergency?
lines.roman: Dahaengieyo. Eunggeup sanghwangeneun mwol josimhaeya haeyo?

lines.beaver: 환자를 함부로 움직이지 말고 바로 신고하세요.
lines.beaver_en: Don't move the patient carelessly, and call for help right away.
lines.beaver_roman: Hwanjareul hamburo umjigiji malgo baro singohaseyo.
lines.en: So not only first aid, but calling for help matters too.

lines.beaver: 네. 이제 아버님을 보러 들어가셔도 됩니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. You may go in to see your father now.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne. Ije abeonimeul boreo deureogasyeodo doemnida.
lines.learner: 정말 감사합니다. 지금 바로 가 볼게요.
lines.en: Thank you so much. I'll go right now.
lines.roman: Jeongmal gamsahamnida. Jigeum baro ga bolgeyo.
